segments.text: She is the main character's classmate and closest friend. Although they get along well, they often clash with each other due to differences in ideas. However, this is because she is able to express her true feelings because he is a person with whom she feels comfortable with.
The clashes themselves are more like playful banter. In effect, she is a caring and patient person. She acts like the main character's wife and caretaker.
She comes from an ordinary family. She is athletic and loves sports. She sometimes thinks the main character is a jerk, but she herself self admittingly can be annoying and nag like a mother-in-law.
She likes to take care of her family, making lunch boxes for them without being asked to.
From getchu

Classmate to the protagonist. She is unhappy with the way she is treated due to her status as a rich young lady, she wishes to change that sentiment.

Although she is high class she does not give off that aura. She speaks what she wants to speak, however, conversations do not last long. She is the classic yamato nadeshiko who is attentive in the sense of taking care of men.

In terms of status, she is the heroine of the school and everyone looks up to her. She is frustrated by the fact that she is viewed as a heroine by others. She wishes to hang out with friends, but others around her say, "she really doesn't do that kind of thing, does she?". As a result she doesn't get invited to things.
She also secretly wears red toenail polish, which is prohibited by school rules. This is an expression of her true feelings of not wanting to remain a "heroine".
From getchu

The protagonist. He is childhood friend's with Suzuka. He's neither dumb or smart, he's average, generic, and bland. At worst, he can be indecisive and emotional.

He is very interested in sex, especially because he's at that age. He's even interested in sex with people he doesn't particularly have any interest in, his desire is so strong he is ready for the act whenever wherever.
From getchu
A woman of few words. She is a sadist at heart with a lustful thought process. She has a rather dark personality.

She finds motivation in teasing the main character, however, she doesn't enjoy just sexual acts. Sexual acts are just a part of teasing for her, and her interest in actual sexual intercourse is very low.

She is a queen by profession, she teaches and does sex work as a part time job. She doesn't have the mindset of making others feel good for the sake of it. Her sexual satisfaction comes from different motives, by subduing and humiliating others.
She becomes incredibly interested and attached to the main protagonist. She also wishes to bring Suzuka into her world.
From getchu

She is a music teacher at the school where the main character attends. She is a calm and fluffy character who is often difficult to grasp, and conversations with her are sometimes difficult to engage in.
According to Taichi, she has a high tolerance for sexually explicit material.
From getchu
She retains her appearance of an elementary school student. She has a severe complex over her young appearance.

Her thought process is more akin to that of a man, she has boyish tendencies. She does not like people who are surprised to learn that she is a girl. She does not like wearing skirts but has no choice when it comes to her school uniform.

She can be quite aggressive in sexual acts to counteract her youthful looks. She does not care who she is with, but when she is made fun of, she wants to experience the more physical side of her partner's sexuality.
From getchu
